root_cause: The gate incorrectly equated existence of an AppData\Roaming\MetaQuotes\Terminal origin mapping for the isolated runtime clone with failure of /portable mode. MetaTrader portable mode is defined by storing mutable terminal data in the installation directory; a metadata mapping directory can still exist. The old predicate therefore produced a false fail after a correctly supervised isolated launch.
correction: Do not reject a runtime clone merely because an origin mapping exists.
Audit any matching roaming mapping and permit only a metadata-only stub containing origin.txt and optional portable.txt, with no subdirectories or other payload.
Require positive local mutable activity under known portable data roots inside MT5_B.
Recheck the active Darwinex origin.txt hash during the portable gate.
Persist M2B5 roaming-stub and local-delta evidence before promotion.
scientific_effect: Infrastructure gate correction only; no alpha, Candidate3, CERT, deployment, portfolio or trading rule changed.
